section.5: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer

5.name_native: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer

hadiths.text: Abu Ma'mar reported:There was an Amir in Mecca who pronounced taslim twice. Abdullah said: Where did he get this sunnah? Al-Hakam said: There is a hadith to the effect that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did like It
